title: 第17章 击杀袁斌第18章 两位大队长
content_zh:
“咔嚓！咔嚓～”
几天后，一个不起眼的狗熊洞中传出奇怪的摩擦声。
“嘭！”
一道巨大的爆炸声响起，狗熊洞炸开，尘土四散。
一个浑身散发着淡淡血色光芒的少年出现。
“血气诀第二层，完成。”
“我在体修方面，果然有天赋。”
江平安之前修炼呼吸吐纳法，用了大量灵石堆积，花了一个月才达到练气四层。
而修炼血气诀，只用了不到一半资源和时间，就完成了血气诀第二层。
江平安握了握拳头，感受着这股爆炸性的力量，有种能一拳将山轰碎的错觉。
当然，这就是错觉。
完成血气诀第二层，他感觉体内血气澎湃，身上的伤口都在快速恢复。
与用灵气滋养伤口不同，体内血气会自己恢复伤势，而且速度更快一些。
“嘭！”
远处突然传来一声巨大的轰鸣。
江平安吓了一大跳，快速钻进草丛之中隐藏自己。
虽然不知道发生了什么，但这个世界太危险了，要好好隐藏自己。
过了一盏茶的功夫，江平安感觉没事了，正要起身，忽然听到了什么，又迅速趴下。
一个衣衫褴褛，浑身是伤的男子摇摇晃晃地从林子里钻出。
男子断了一只胳膊，身上伤口正在不断流血。

男人趴在旁边的池塘大口地喝了几口水。
“一群王八蛋！老夫要不是境界跌落，一根手指头就能按死你们！”
“还有那个小王八，要不是拿走了老夫的阵旗，老夫也不会这么惨！”
“你们这些人都等着！等着老夫重新崛起，一定将你们碎尸万段！”
此人不是别人，正是被追杀了好几天的袁斌。
因为与士兵的交易没完成，对方想要拿他开刀。
虽说他境界跌落了，但毕竟有点底蕴。
面对两名堪比练气九层的武者，还是让他逃出来了。
但他也付出了巨大代价，境界又跌了一层，只有练气七层的修为了。
袁斌正要歇息，忽然察觉到了什么，猛地回头。
看到那张熟悉的面孔，袁斌面露狂喜。
竟然是偷走他阵旗和血色眼镜的小子！
“哈哈哈！老夫的宝物又回来了！”
没想到自己运气这么好，又碰到了对方！
江平安也没想到会在这里遇到对方，见到对方，心中的杀意就如同江河一般奔腾。
他忘不了鞭子抽在脸上的感觉，他忘不掉被对方捅碎自己眼睛时的痛苦，他忘不掉那一遍遍痛苦的轮回。
见这男人重伤，江平安毫不客气地选择了偷袭。
只是对方的感知非常灵敏，还没等完全靠近，就被察觉了。
此刻已经无法收手，江平安抬起手里的刀加速冲过去。
“尔等小辈也想偷袭老夫！去死吧！”

袁斌单手掐诀，准备释放火球术将对方解决。
但是就在这一刻，他忽然感觉手指一僵，术法施展到一半突然停住，施法被打断。
袁斌脸色骤变。
content_en:
"Click! Click~"
A few days later, a strange friction sound came from an inconspicuous bear cave.
"Bang!"
A huge explosion sounded, the Bear Cave exploded, and dust was scattered.
A young man with a faint blood-colored light appeared.
"The second level of Blood Qi Jue is completed."
"I'm really talented in physical training."
Jiang Ping'an used to practice the breathing and breathing method, using a large amount of spiritual stones to accumulate, and it took him a month to reach the fourth level of Qi training.
As for practicing the Blood and Qi Art, it only took less than half of the resources and time to complete the second level of the Blood and Qi Art.
Jiang Ping'an clenched his fist, feeling the explosive power, and had the illusion that he could break the mountain with one punch.
Of course, this is an illusion.
After completing the second level of the Blood Qi Art, he felt the blood surging in his body, and the wounds on his body were healing quickly.
Unlike using spiritual energy to nourish the wound, the blood energy in the body will heal the injury on its own, and faster.
"Bang!"
Suddenly there was a huge roar in the distance.
Jiang Ping'an was startled and quickly got into the grass to hide himself.
Although I don’t know what happened, this world is too dangerous and I have to hide myself well.
After a cup of tea, Jiang Ping'an felt okay. He was about to get up when he suddenly heard something and quickly lay down again.
A man in ragged clothes and covered in injuries staggered out of the woods.
The man had a broken arm and the wound on his body was bleeding.
The man lay down in the pond next to him and drank a few gulps of water.
"A bunch of bastards! If I hadn't fallen into disgrace, I could have pinned you to death with one finger!"
"And that little bastard, if he hadn't taken away my formation flag, I wouldn't be so miserable!"
"You guys are just waiting! When I rise again, I will tear you into pieces!"
This person was none other than Yuan Bin, who had been hunted for several days.
Because the deal with the soldier was not completed, the other party wanted to take action on him.
Although his realm has fallen, he still has some foundation.
Facing two warriors who were comparable to the ninth level of Qi training, he was still allowed to escape.
But he also paid a huge price, and his realm dropped another level, only reaching the seventh level of Qi training.
Yuan Bin was about to take a rest when he suddenly noticed something and turned around suddenly.
Seeing that familiar face, Yuan Bin looked ecstatic.
It turned out to be the boy who stole his formation flag and blood-colored glasses!
"Hahaha! My treasure is back again!"
I didn’t expect that I would be so lucky to meet the other person again!
Jiang Ping'an didn't expect to meet the other party here. When he saw the other party, the murderous intention in his heart surged like a river.
He couldn't forget the feeling of the whip on his face, he couldn't forget the pain when his eyes were broken by the other party, and he couldn't forget the painful reincarnation over and over again.
Seeing that the man was seriously injured, Jiang Pingan unceremoniously chose a sneak attack.
It's just that the opponent's perception is very sensitive, and he was noticed before he was completely close.
Unable to hold back at this moment, Jiang Ping'an raised the knife in his hand and rushed over quickly.
"You juniors also want to attack me! Go to hell!"
Yuan Bin made a secret with one hand, preparing to release the fireball technique to kill the opponent.
But at this moment, he suddenly felt his fingers stiffen, and the spell suddenly stopped in the middle of casting, and the spell was interrupted.
Yuan Bin's expression suddenly changed.
